top_signals.title: AI Stocks Rally After Coreweave's Results; Treasury Market Closed
top_signals.summary: US equity futures rise after Coreweave's strong results and robust demand for Anthropic's IPO. US Treasury futures fall after a hot inflation print fueled Fed rate-hike bets and fueled a spike in yields. Cash Treasury market is closed for Veterans Day holiday. Olaolu Aganga of Citi discusses the sustainability of the AI-driven tech rally. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: India Eyes 50% Wind Power Capacity Boost Without Acquiring More Land
top_signals.summary: India’s wind turbine manufacturers are in discussions with state and federal authorities about a plan to repower old turbines with higher-capacity, higher-efficiency new ones to boost power output without sacrificing more land.   Modern turbines can replace a total of 8 gigawatts (GW) of old and less efficient turbines, Aditya Pyasi, CEO of the Indian Wind Turbine Manufacturers Association, told Bloomberg in an interview published on Wednesday. The repowering project could boost capacity at these sites by nearly 50%, according to estimates…

top_signals.title: UK investment platforms line up for Anthropic’s landmark $1.4tn float
top_signals.summary: Several of the UK’s top investment platforms have begun accepting orders from retail investors for shares in Anthropic, as the Claude maker gears up for one of one of the biggest IPOs of all time. top_signals.summary: N-able released hotfixes to address zero-day bugs affecting its N-central remote monitoring and management (RMM) platform, which were publicly disclosed over the weekend and forced it to take vulnerable hosted environments offline. [...]
